name: metric
title: Metric
description: Displays a numeric reading with tabular figures and aligned units.
docs: Vlak leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/vlak-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

vlak.example:
import { Metric } from "@noorddev/vlak-react";

<Metric label="Estimated range" value={386} unit="km" description="Ready for your next journey" comparison="18 km more than yesterday" />

use: Dashboard readings, vehicle status, and concise numeric comparisons.

keyboard.does: Static reading; no additional keyboard stop.

a11y: The label, formatted value, and unit are readable text. Provide a text equivalent for an optional trend graphic.
